prompt: Break this work down into tickets our developers can pick up. First look at the codebase if there is one, then give me the tickets.
spec: The orders list page is too slow; customers complain. Nobody has measured anything yet.
Make it fast enough that support stops hearing about it.

expect.check: no pointer to an external spec as the task body
acceptance criteria contain a measurable bound (a number) that fails on the current code; the first ticket establishes the measurement
no ticket promises to make it faster without a measurable criterion
